effects.summary: You hew downward and make the air, dust, fragments, shields, and fear fall with the blow. Creatures of your choice in the area make a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: A creature takes 8d6 bludgeoning or slashing damage, falls Prone, and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: A creature takes half damage and does not fall Prone. Objects, fragile cover, unattended shields, loose barricades, and nonmagical wooden or bone structures in the area may be damaged at the GM's discretion. This is not a Weather, Earth, or Destruction domain. It is the shock of an axe blow spreading through things already able to fall, split, or break. Cost: 4 CP or 4 Stamina
